description: This PHP class 'FormatWithPurgeString' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface and provides a method to format values by always returning the string 'Purged'. It is part of a maintenance purge strategy within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for formatting values related to its purge process.

classes.name: FormatWithPurgeString
classes.description: A class that formats a value by returning a constant string 'Purged'. Implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the string 'Purged' regardless of input, used for formatting values in purge strategy.
